The '''Kuat City Spaceport''' was the main [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] of [[Kuat City]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]].<ref name=":0">''[[Star Wars Adventures 5: The Shape-Shifter Strikes]]''</ref>

The spaceport was remarkably clean, and virtually every [[Kuati/Legends|Kuati]] that traversed its elegant, open spaces wore elegant clothes. For although billions of beings were employed in the [[Space station/Legends|orbital stations]] and stardocks surrounding Kuat, few actually set foot on the planet itself—which was inhabited primarily by wealthy Kuati [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]], their families, and their servants. And the Kuati didn't welcome "[[outlander]]s". The spaceport had many shops, including one that sold fine clothing.<ref name=":0" />

In [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]], [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]], whose services were subcontracted by [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], infiltrated Kuat's tight security and defenses to pass through the spaceport on her way to track down the criminal [[Hurlo Holowan]], whose [[Droid/Legends|droid]]-[[Engineer/Legends|engineering]] talents and ingenuity were sought by [[Dooku/Legends|Darth Tyranus]].<ref name=":0" />
